title: Premier Mai, Meiji Jingū, shopping, Street Kart
summary: Breakfast in Tomigaya, through Yoyogi Park to Meiji Jingū, Takeshita Street, then Cynthia's shopping afternoon in Omotesando while G does Harajuku and Nintendo. Street Kart at golden hour, then ramen and a foot massage.

rows.detail: PATH was temporarily closed. The hidden café in Tomigaya instead, a hit (How-to 26).
Five minutes away. Walk through to the Harajuku gate. Sunday rockabilly dancers near that entrance.
Forest paths and the big torii. About 45 minutes.
Out of the Harajuku gate and across the road. Walk it once together.
Pre-owned shops: Brand Collect, Brand Collect Omotesando 2, Kindal Harajuku, RAGTAG Harajuku, ALLU, Brand Collect Shibuya.
ZARA Harajuku was closed. Booked tonight's massage at Mominotakumi in person, then ZARA Shibuya Kōen-dōri, H&M Udagawachō and Nintendo Tokyo. Egg sando from 7-Eleven for lunch.
Fully closed shoes. Physical licence cards, physical International Driving Permits, passports. No digital copies.
Check which shop the voucher names (How-to 25). Aim to arrive by 15:30.
About two hours. Golden hour over the bay.
Same way back, or a taxi.
Izakaya in the basement of the Dōgenzaka Building, by the station. Sauce yakisoba, negi-shio cucumber, menchi katsu, zha cai. ¥3,971 for two, including a ¥550 cover charge each.
SUNX Building 9F, Jinnan. Booked for 2. Then Yakitori Toriton, 3 minutes away and open late, or Ichiran in the same block.
